messages:
Jordan: Quick thread to finalize customer comms + who owns the follow-ups for last night's outage. Need status page copy, who gets full RCA, and a remediation owner for recurring network flaps.
Priya: I'll draft the public blurb. Recommend two-step comms: public summary tonight, detailed RCA to contract customers after legal sign-off.
Marco: Ops: confirmed window 01:05-01:52 UTC. ~22k retries, ~310 5xx. No auth/data exposure.
Lena: Product/support coordination: Support should own the distribution list; Product owns public copy; Engineering authors the RCA.
support-bot: Support: will prepare affected-customer list once legal approves distribution policy.
legal-bot: Legal: full RCAs only to customers covered by contract/NDA. Public page must explicitly state whether customer data was exposed.
Priya: Draft status page snippet: "Resolved: brief service degradation in us-west (01:05-01:52 UTC). Impact: increased latency and intermittent failed requests; no customer data exposed. Mitigation: config rollback and cache persistence. Full RCA will be provided to affected contract customers after review."
Jordan: Add a line: "We're scheduling a targeted reliability review to investigate recurring network flaps." Keep wording neutral about vendors.
Marco: I'll open infra follow-up ticket (owner: Marco, due in 7 days) to track the recurring pattern and propose fixes.
Lena: Action items:
- Marco: paste final timeline + counts into postmortem (by 11:00 PT)
- Priya: publish public status + customer email draft (by 18:00 PT)
- Support: prepare affected-customer list and distribution plan (by COB)
- Legal: review and approve detailed RCA distribution (by next business day)
Jordan: Also add monitoring alert: rolling count of network flaps over 14d to trigger an on-call review.
Priya: Posting draft to #incidents-drafts for quick review. Please keep comms concise and focus on impact, mitigation, and next steps.
Jordan: Thanks all. Plan: public summary tonight, targeted RCAs to contracts after legal sign-off tomorrow. :thumbsup:
